title: Kitchenware
tagline: A personal centerpiece for the kitchen.
description: Cutting boards, serving boards, recipe keepsakes, and gifts for the table.
brief: Board dimensions and intended use help us choose a useful engraving area.
note: Woodgrain and engraving contrast vary naturally. Tell us whether the piece is for food preparation or display.

title: Trophies
tagline: Make the win memorable.
description: Championship cups, team awards, and personalized bases that celebrate the achievement.
brief: Send the award title, winner names, and presentation date.
note: For a group of awards, include a spreadsheet or list with the exact wording for each recipient.

title: Medals
tagline: A small award with a big meaning.
description: Personalized medals for sports, school events, clubs, and milestone achievements.
brief: Tell us the event, medal count, finish preference, and ribbon needs.
note: Include the medal diameter and whether front, back, or both sides should be personalized.

title: Tumblers
tagline: Their everyday drink. Their own design.
description: Custom names, logos, and wrap concepts for tumblers, bottles, and travel drinkware.
brief: Include capacity, brand or model, and your preferred base color.
note: Artwork color is a design preference. The engraving result depends on the coating and underlying material.

title: Glassware
tagline: Make the next toast personal.
description: Engraved wine glasses, rocks glasses, mugs, and matching gift sets.
brief: Share the glass style, set size, and engraving placement.
note: Simple, high-contrast artwork is a strong starting point for a clear etched design.

title: Custom Printing
tagline: Bring your artwork into everyday life.
description: Colorful graphics for shirts, gifts, panels, and compatible personal items.
brief: Send the intended item, print dimensions, artwork, and quantity.
note: We’ll confirm a suitable process after reviewing your substrate and the artwork.

title: Canvas Prints
tagline: Give a favorite image room to shine.
description: Photo canvases, family portraits, artwork reproductions, and meaningful wall pieces.
materials: Size and finish to be confirmed
brief: Provide the original image, preferred size, and portrait or landscape orientation.
note: Leave room around important faces and lettering if you want the artwork to wrap around an edge.

title: Custom Lighters
tagline: A compact canvas for a personal mark.
description: Detailed designs, names, and messages on compatible metal lighters and lighter cases.
brief: Specify the exact lighter or case model and the surfaces to customize.
note: For customer-supplied items, send a clear photo and dimensions before finalizing the project.

title: Bottles & Decanters
tagline: A gift worth displaying.
description: Engraved bottle and decanter projects for milestones, celebrations, and personal collections.
brief: Include a photo of the bottle, the label position, and the desired engraving area.
note: This is a personalization request for the vessel. Contents and product sourcing are discussed separately.

title: Wedding Items
tagline: Details that feel like the two of you.
description: Keepsake boxes, table details, personalized glassware, favors, and bridal party gifts.
brief: Tell us the wedding date, theme, quantities, and which items should coordinate.
note: Provide guest names in one checked list when ordering individually personalized pieces.

title: Signs & Decor
tagline: Make a space feel like yours.
description: Personal signs, slate portraits, housewarming gifts, and decorative pieces.
brief: Send the size, intended location, and how the piece will be displayed.
note: Outdoor exposure, mounting, and material suitability are reviewed before the final quote.

title: Awards & Keepsakes
tagline: Recognition with a personal signature.
description: Engraved plaques, decorative medallions, coins, and milestone keepsakes.
brief: Include the occasion, exact award wording, dimensions, and quantity.
note: For a presentation piece, tell us whether you need a stand, display case, or gift packaging.

title: Apparel & Patches
tagline: Give the whole crew a common thread.
description: Custom shirts, hats, team gear, and personalized leather-patch concepts.
brief: Send garment sizes, colors, placement, and the quantity in each size.
note: Patch appearance and attachment depend on the garment, material, and selected production method.

title: DTF Transfers
tagline: Your design. Ready for your press.
description: Gang sheets and individual transfers for your next apparel or merchandise run.
brief: Specify final artwork dimensions, quantity, and the garment type.
note: Use the sheet planner for repeated designs, or upload a prepared sheet with your project request.

title: Phone Cases
tagline: A personal look for the device you carry.
description: Photo, artwork, monogram, and logo concepts for compatible phone cases.
brief: Enter the exact phone model and case model, plus any grip or charging requirements.
note: Phone generations can have different camera openings. Fit is confirmed before ordering a blank.

title: Gaming Covers
tagline: Make the setup unmistakably yours.
description: Custom artwork concepts for compatible console faceplates and gaming accessories.
brief: List the exact console model, generation, and disc or digital version.
note: Only compatible existing cover blanks are considered; dimensions and fit must be verified.

title: Laptop Cases
tagline: A cover with your own point of view.
description: Personal photo, artwork, and brand concepts for compatible laptop shells.
brief: Include the laptop model number, year, screen size, and shell details.
note: Ventilation and openings must stay clear; the exact shell fit is reviewed before production.

title: Stickers & Decals
tagline: Small details. Plenty of personality.
description: Logo decals, label concepts, and artwork transfers for compatible hard surfaces.
materials: UV transfer for compatible hard surface
brief: Share the application surface, finished dimensions, and quantity.
note: Adhesion and durability depend on the material and intended use. Include whether it will be washed or used outdoors.

title: Glow Effects
tagline: A different look when the lights change.
description: Glow-style apparel and graphic concepts for bold custom projects.
brief: Tell us the desired visual effect, garment type, placement, and print size.
note: The effect, available colors, and care instructions depend on the approved specialty material.

title: Keychains & Promo
tagline: Your brand, ready to go.
description: Personalized keychains, small gifts, and branded handouts for teams and events.
brief: Specify the item, dimensions, quantity, and whether each piece needs a unique name.
note: Share your budget per piece so we can discuss a practical material and finish.
